readerCopy.body: A fantasy that keeps returning may be trying to tell you something much simpler than the fantasy itself. When Neptune conjuncts Lilith, a desire you have been reluctant to name can show up as daydreaming, fixation, art, longing, attraction, or the wish to disappear into a completely different life. Do not assume the whole fantasy needs to become literal. Ask what repeats inside it. More privacy, more freedom, more affection, more creative time, less scrutiny, or a different kind of work may be the ordinary need underneath the dramatic version. Start with the need you can actually name.
